2f4e5f5b-d930-4266-8c8a-c4cf9a81e51f.title: Jahy-sama wa Kujikenai!
2f4e5f5b-d930-4266-8c8a-c4cf9a81e51f.altTitle: The Great Jahy Will Not Be Defeated!
2f4e5f5b-d930-4266-8c8a-c4cf9a81e51f.description:
Jahy-sama (pronounced jah-hee) is an existence to be feared and respected throughout the Demon Realm. Well, was. The (former) Demon Realm No. 2 is now busy with house chores and work... in the human realm! Her dinner is just beansprouts, and she can't afford anything except water at cafes, but she won't get discouraged!
___
**Note:**
Jahy's shirt says '魔界復興', which seems to translate to "Demon Realm Restoration".

42289724-53ab-4016-9812-cdb6a7d7ea0a.title: Scavengers Another Sky
42289724-53ab-4016-9812-cdb6a7d7ea0a.description: In the shadowy research facility known as 'Bus Stop,' a group of armed girls called 'Scavengers' operate. They are dispatched to mysterious realms referred to by the initials 'BP' (Black Parade), where treasures are said to sleep. But what lurks there are otherworldly ghosts...!? Explore! Defeat!! Collect!!! In a bid to gather one million dollars and earn their freedom, these girls embark on a life-threatening journey to scavenge!

96ae166c-d8e1-4e9e-88cb-805b65154d7e.title: Red Blue
96ae166c-d8e1-4e9e-88cb-805b65154d7e.description: Suzuki Aoba, a gloomy, social outcast, is satisfied with his Highschool life though he occasionally gets beaten up by his classmate Iwase Sannosuke in "play-fights". One day, Aoba is saved from a "play-fight" by none other than Akasawa Kenshin, a boy from the class next door and the rising rookie superstar sensation of the MMA world. However, Kenshin wonders aloud if Aoba feels empty when Aoba states that he doesn't have a dream, which Aoba doesn't react to kindly. He vows to land one punch on Kenshin in the future. Aobas joins the Shark Gym lead by the sloppy Kanenari Tokiwa to achieve his dream of besting Kenshin.

chapters.title: Training with the Four Heavenly Kings
A game with lives on the line.
If it slips, reach for it.
If I die, I’m taking you with me.

26513cab-0b61-482c-aa7c-d042d4fe1914.title: Namjuga Je Geongange Jipchakamnida
26513cab-0b61-482c-aa7c-d042d4fe1914.altTitle: The Male Lead Is Unhealthily Obsessed With My Health
26513cab-0b61-482c-aa7c-d042d4fe1914.description: The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

b2b78622-2247-4edb-b696-ae96b4617f71.title: Yuuyuu Jiteki.
b2b78622-2247-4edb-b696-ae96b4617f71.description:
The serious and level-headed college student Suzuki Chihiro meets an ultra-positive senior coworker Washio Miyu when he starts working part-time at a convenience store after moving.

“Let's make some fun memories now!”

Her unpredictable “play” as she enjoys the moment to the fullest gradually transforms his boring and drab daily life. Their slightly off-kilter conversations set their days in motion in unexpected ways.
___

6ab0ecac-bdc2-4a5a-92c3-f337f4347d4b.title: Kaiki Tantei Sharaku Homura
6ab0ecac-bdc2-4a5a-92c3-f337f4347d4b.altTitle: Sharaku Homura: Detective of the Uncanny
6ab0ecac-bdc2-4a5a-92c3-f337f4347d4b.description:
In Shimoyama Middle School, the Experiment Club and Karate Club each only have one member left, and as a result, must share one classroom. These two students, Sharaku Homura and Yamazaki Yousuke (a.k.a Karate Kid) together solve numerous impossible mysteries that they happen to run into!
Originally a doujinshi by Nemoto Shou, now an award-winning manga, having won the Hokkaido Mystery Cross Match Award!

aae85a31-1e90-4359-95cb-4db07b638bd3.title: Kamisama ga Mitenai kara
aae85a31-1e90-4359-95cb-4db07b638bd3.description: Sakuya, who was raised in a church, was supposed to be living a modest but warm life alongside Sister Lamia, or that's how it should have been...! Though she tries to appear seductive, she's actually pure. Though she can be slightly dimwitted, she's adorable. Even though he tries to resist, Sakuya is continuously being led around her.

d00bd104-d9b2-4ee9-a088-b5065d1c406a.title: Toaru Majutsu no Index Gaiden - Toaru Kagaku no Railgun
d00bd104-d9b2-4ee9-a088-b5065d1c406a.description:
Welcome to a world where mysticism and science collide, and supernatural powers are derived from either science or religion. At the heart of this world is Academy City, an advanced metropolis whose population is comprised mostly of students The majority of students are enrolled in the city's "Power Curriculum Program," where they must learn to master their latent psychic powers. Out of several million students, only seven are deemed powerful enough to have Level 5 status.

Meet Mikoto Misaka, the third most powerful Level 5 ESPer in Academy City. Together with her best friends Kuroko Shirai and the other members of Judgment, a student-run law enforcement agency, Mikoto delves deep into the dark heart of the scientific sprawl she calls home, and uncovers secrets she wishes she hadn't!

5294637b-2217-4df7-aa25-800a26500933.title: Ano Ko wa Kishi
5294637b-2217-4df7-aa25-800a26500933.description: Since childhood, Katsutoshi Himemiya often dreamed of a medieval world where knights protected the princess. He lived his life vaguely thinking, “Maybe I was a knight in a previous life,” but when he met Asako Kishi at his high school entrance ceremony, he realized that his previous life was as a princess and hers was as a knight...
